narration: You don't need to edit your source files just to test a design change. Open the Elements panel, find the CSS rule, and change the value directly. Watch — I'll change the border radius from twelve pixels to thirty-two. The page updates instantly. No save, no reload, no build step.
desc: Demo app with cards at 12px border-radius

The Console isn't just for reading logs. It's a live JavaScript REPL. You can run any code against the current page. For example, I can grab the title element and change its text right here. The page updates immediately. No editor required.

If an API call fails, the Network panel tells you exactly what happened. I'll click Load Users, which fetches data from a local API. The request appears here. Click it, and you can see the headers that were sent, the response body, and the timing breakdown. Everything you need to debug a failed request.
desc: Demo app with empty user list

narration: Want to test how your app handles no internet? The Network panel has a throttling dropdown. Set it to Offline, reload the page, and you can see exactly what happens when the connection drops. The page fails to load, and you can debug the error handling — all without pulling your ethernet cable.
